name: PGC 10922 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 10922, a lenticular galaxy ringed by faint shells, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc10922-hubble
story: Faint arcs and shells spread outward from this galaxy, likely left by a gravitational encounter or merger, while tightly wound spirals of dust circle its bright center.

claims.text: It has faint wide arcs or shells, likely from a gravitational encounter or merger
Tightly wound spirals of dark dust encircle its bright center
PGC 10922 is an early-type poststarburst galaxy with shells, likely a merger remnant
